body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_{\mathsf A}(g_0,h_0,\kappa)\), the support batch satisfies \(\Pr_P(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{sup}})=1\). On \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{sup}}\), the procedure recovers the deterministic support \(\mathcal S\) and its canonical frame \(U\) exactly, samples without inversion for \(r<r_0\), and begins covariance inversion and all spectral and projector tests in \(\mathbb R^n\) only at \(r_0=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil\). Moreover, \[\Pr_P\!\left(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{sup}},\ \widehat{\mathcal G}=\operatorname{TC}(\mathcal G_{\mathcal E})=I^{-1}\operatorname{TC}(\mathcal G)I,\ \mathcal L_{\mathrm{enc}}(\widehat H,P)\le\tau,\ \text{and return occurs by }B_{\mathrm{samp}}\text{ cumulative post-support samples per environment}\right)\ge1-\alpha.\] On this event the observational environment uses at most \(B_0=n+B_{\mathrm{samp}}\) observations including the disjoint support batch, every intervention environment uses at most \(B_{\mathrm{samp}}\), and the combined budget is at most \(B_{\mathrm{tot}}=n+(n+1)B_{\mathrm{samp}}\). At any certified stage \(r\ge r_0\) with primitive radius \(e_r\), there exists \(H^{\star}\) with \(H^{\star}_{m,:}{}^{\top}\in\mathcal S\), \(\|H^{\star}_{m,:}\|_2=1\), and \(U^{\top}H^{\star}_{m,:}{}^{\top}\in\operatorname{col}(R_m)\) for every \(m\), such that \(\|\widehat H-H^{\star}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\|\widehat H-H^{\star}\|_{\mathrm F}\le4\sqrt n\,e_r/g_0\), and \((H^{\star}G)_{m,I(j)}=0\) whenever \(j\ne m\) and \(j\not\to m\) in \(\mathcal G_{\mathcal E}\). No eigenvalue margin for a subset absent from \(\mathfrak T_{\mathsf A}(P)\) appears in the guarantee.
body.justification: It is the positive kernel of the query-local beta-min boundary and yields a permutation-equivariant recover-or-abstain guarantee.
body.gap: Acartürk et al. require the global all-subset \(\eta^{\ast}\) condition together with the separate printed \(\gamma^{\ast}\) threshold condition and do not give an anytime-valid abstention contract or a covariance-specialized encoder range bar.
body.consumer: The official finite-sample linear CRL package can expose public gaps, certified ties, graph abstention, and encoder error bars.
